dedupe_keys.name: reproducibility package for artificial intelligence digital twins and cyber resilience in water distribution systems a review and benchmark perspective

description: The package contains anomaly-detection code, configurations, model checkpoints and derived outputs for a water-distribution testbed. It also audits provenance and preprocessing for the aNomalies dataset. This resource is provided by PEREZ PEREZ, ESVAN DE JESUS. Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. The provider lists ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Original WDT and aNomalies data are not redistributed. The provider says no detector was trained or evaluated on aNomalies. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
